A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TexGaussian work. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–C are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original ShapeNet and Objaverse experiments, quantitative results in Tables 1–3, qualitative generations, and octree and loss ablations.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds a qualitative Make-it-Real comparison and additional generated examples.

M1.justification: Appendix B revises the stated RGB-only U-Net output from 13 to 11 channels because material information is absent; the text-conditioned model retains 13. This is a limited revision to the reported output architecture. Gaussian placement, regression losses, and texture baking remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain four-category ShapeNet RGB texturing and text-conditioned PBR generation on the same curated Objaverse subset. Figure 12 adds garden and building examples within the existing mesh-texturing task, without establishing a separate benchmark or evaluation scenario.

E2.justification: v2 adds Make-it-Real to the qualitative PBR comparison in Figure 5 and Section 4.3. Fantasia3D, FlashTex, and DreamMat remain. Make-it-Real is not added to quantitative Table 2, and the ShapeNet comparators are unchanged.

E3.justification: The new Make-it-Real comparison uses meshes paired with TexGaussian-generated albedo maps. Appendix B also revises the stated RGB-only output configuration from 13 to 11 channels. Existing splits, rendering views, metrics, and training budgets remain unchanged; these revisions do not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Section 4.4 retains the same octree-versus-full-voxel comparison and 2D/3D loss ablations, including Table 3 and Figures 6–8. No additional ablation, robustness test, or separate diagnostic study is introduced.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The existing averaging over 20 rendering views and reporting of point estimates and training curves remain unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–3 remain unchanged. Figure 5 adds Make-it-Real outputs, with reported nearly constant material maps and problematic metallic rendering. Appendix Figure 12 adds garden and church-like building generations while retaining the earlier examples.

T1.justification: The loss equations and Appendix A's Gaussian definitions and rendering formulas retain their mathematical content. Replacing RGB subscripts with albedo and changing equation punctuation do not introduce new definitions, derivations, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about direct 3D PBR generation, octant-aligned Gaussians, regression-based speed, visual quality, and geometric consistency. The novelty statement is grammatically revised without changing its scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 newly attributes Make-it-Real's nearly constant PBR maps and excessive metallic appearance to difficulty capturing overall 3D structure. Existing interpretations of the ablations and limitations concerning training-data scale and complex unseen objects remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendix B corrects the RGB-only output-channel specification and explicitly distinguishes it from the 13-channel PBR model. Section 4.3 documents the albedo inputs supplied to Make-it-Real. Hardware, optimizer settings, training times, and code/model access information are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds references and discussion for Meta 3D TextureGen, Paint-it, and Make-it-Real, while removing GenesisTex. These are limited updates within the existing research positioning and three-part related-work organization.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized grammar and terminology edits, consistently identifies albedo supervision, revises several comparison passages, and adds a funding acknowledgment. The section sequence and appendix organization remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Figure 5 gains a Make-it-Real column, and Figure 12 expands from six to eight examples. Figure 3 and Table 2 relocate, several panels are resized, and Figure 8's caption is shortened. The overall two-column design and existing visual evidence are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly strengthens the paper through an additional qualitative comparator, explicit documentation of its inputs, and a clearer distinction between RGB-only and PBR output channels. Updated literature coverage and additional examples also help. The numerical evidence and existing ablations remain unchanged, and the new comparator receives no quantitative evaluation, limiting the overall gain.
